fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-12-31, the sister of the complainant, Latha Selvi, aged 22, left for a local errand and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Nallur Colony College Road in Madurai. The time of the incident was given as 02:45 on 2025-12-29. The complaint was lodged by Abirami Bai (9000000059), a family member of Latha Selvi, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000459. Arun Babu (9000000379) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Sanjay Mani (9000000120), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
